note: Ratchet on new-code duplication (night-rick#376). Duplicated added lines in a diff must not exceed baseline. A raise above 0 needs a non-empty reason, a future expiry date, and an owner; check fails once the expiry passes. A raise inside the diff under review does not take effect until it merges: the ratchet judges against the baseline as it stood at the base ref. Lower the baseline when a PR's count drops below it.
